# iru_user (Data Source)

Reads one existing directory integration user by exact UUID. Returns identity/status metadata for selecting device assignments. Personal metadata remains in Terraform state. Does not create, modify or delete the directory user.

Only the documented exact-UUID GET is used. A missing object reports an error; the lookup does not create a replacement or modify assignments. Omitted API status fields remain null rather than becoming invented defaults.

## Example Usage


```terraform
data "iru_user" "example" {
  user_id = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-4ccc-8ddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) Exact directory-user UUID. Deprecated integer IDs and name/email searches are not accepted.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Reported active status, or null if omitted.
- `archived` (Boolean) Reported archived status, or null if omitted.
- `email` (String) Reported directory email address, or null if omitted.
- `id` (String) Canonical directory-user UUID.
- `name` (String) Reported directory display name, or null if omitted.
